item.title: Version 0.7.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Settings ▸ System Wallpaper: see which extension copy macOS loaded, inspect and repair stale registrations, restart the wallpaper service, and optionally recover a stalled connection automatically (macOS 26)
  • Settings ▸ Overlays: widget tint, opacity, Liquid Glass and the temperature unit in one place
  • The Settings sidebar is grouped into Setup, Playback, Content, Data and Support, with Audio Response and Weather merged into Integrations
  • Pro: more Wallpaper Engine puppet models load — .mdl versions are read from a feature table instead of an allowlist, including MDLV0013 puppets

Improvements

  • The System Wallpaper library has search and the shared grid; playback scope and bulk removal live in Settings
  • A system wallpaper video that fails to play is reported in the app, and the extension retries it
  • The System Wallpaper status updates live while the page is open
  • Failure details and diagnostic logs open inside the window instead of a sheet
  • Loomscreen's own window pauses the wallpaper when it covers a display, like any other app's

Bug Fixes

  • Pro: text layers and their opaque backgrounds rendered far lighter than image layers with the same authored colour
  • Pro: follow-cursor effects and clicks were offset on displays whose aspect ratio differs from the scene's
  • Pro: MDLV0013 puppets were refused

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
